## Voice mode

- Direct the agent by voice in every chat (classic, RLM and Claaky). Click the 🎙 button in the composer to start; click it again to pause (⌘⇧M).
- Live transcript: your words appear in the composer as you speak, in dimmed italics, and are sent after 2 seconds of silence. Pausing keeps the text so you can edit it, and resuming continues it.
- Spoken reports: at the end of each task the agent writes a short summary, shown in a "Synthèse" card and read aloud. The 🎧 button (⌘⇧D) mutes it, ▶ replays a card and Échap stops playback.
- Speaking while the agent works interrupts it. "stop", "répète" and "mode écrit" work as whole-sentence commands.
- Background noise: only the voice closest to the microphone is transcribed. Background chatter is ignored and no longer delays sending. A live graph in the voice bar shows your voice in color and the background in grey.

## Speech recognition

- macOS uses Apple speech recognition. It runs on the device when Dictation is enabled (System Settings › Keyboard › Dictation). Otherwise you choose: open the settings, use Apple's servers (explicit consent), or use Whisper.
- Windows and Linux use Whisper, free and local (the "base" model is downloaded once, with a checked SHA-256).

## Changes

- The composer's separate Dictée button is gone: the 🎙 button now does everything.
- Linux: the webview can now access the microphone.
